subtitle: Adjust Boat Motor fuel consumption from vanilla drain down to zero.
description: Makes Boat Motor fuel use configurable from 0% to 100% of vanilla consumption. The default is 50%, with live in-game control through optional Mod Settings and a normal BepInEx config fallback.
features: Fuel consumption can be adjusted from 0% to 100% of vanilla.
The default value is 50% of vanilla Boat Motor fuel consumption.
50% uses roughly half the vanilla fuel.
25% uses roughly one quarter of the vanilla fuel.
0% prevents Boat Motor fuel from being consumed while the motor is running.
Optional Stranded Deep Mod Settings integration provides an in-game slider.
The setting remains available through the BepInEx config when Mod Settings is absent.
The multiplier applies to live Boat Motors globally, including local split-screen sessions.
The mod does not store data in the Stranded Deep save file.

faq.question: Does 0% mean unlimited Boat Motor fuel?
faq.answer: Yes. At 0% the mod refunds the normal Boat Motor fuel drain, so the motor does not consume fuel while running.

faq.question: Does the mod change fuel cans or the fuel still?
faq.answer: No. It only adjusts fuel consumption by the Boat Motor.

faq.question: Does it work in local split-screen?
faq.answer: Yes. The setting is global to the game session, so both local players use the same Boat Motor fuel multiplier.

faq.question: Is Mod Settings required?
faq.answer: No. It is a soft dependency. Without Mod Settings the same value is read from the BepInEx configuration file.

faq.question: Can the value be changed without restarting the game?
faq.answer: The Mod Settings slider updates the BepInEx ConfigEntry live. Installing, updating or removing the plugin itself still requires a game restart.

faq.question: Does the mod modify my save?
faq.answer: No. It uses BepInEx configuration and does not write its own state into the Stranded Deep save.
